# v0.1.0: sprite library, Pokédex performance and Live sprites (2026-11-23)

This was a focused pass. The large Summary popup, one tile per species, local dump reuse and Alpha/Swarm notifications are unchanged.

## 1. Alpha/Swarm sprites (Home + Live)

- Report sprites are drawn only at whole-number scales with nearest-neighbour scaling, so they stay sharp:
  - Home and Live rows: 72 px (2× the 36 px box icon);
  - Live detail: 192 px (2× the 96 px battle sprite);
  - narrow containers and popouts: 36 px and 96 px.
- The Home Live card now shows the Pokémon sprite, kind, species, time, title and location.
- A sprite is shown only when the report names its species unambiguously: either the title is the species name, or only one species is named. This is a display-only check; the stored detection and the parser are unchanged.
  - A report that names several Pokémon keeps its species link but gets a neutral icon.
  - The Qt toast receives the same unambiguous-only `species_icon`.
- TEST labels, replay markers, source, parser and delivery details are unchanged.

## 2. Pokédex loading: measured, then fixed

Measurements were taken with headless Chrome on the development machine: median of 5 runs, 649 species, real dump installed, the harness in `tools/` outside the repo. The same harness ran against the starting commit 83bf9c4 and against this pass.

| Measurement | Before | After |
|---|---:|---:|
| Cold load → all 649 cards in the DOM | 390 ms | 274 ms |
| Cold load → first screen of sprites downloaded | 891 ms | 432 ms |
| Home → Pokédex (first visit) | 221 ms | 184 ms |
| Return to Pokédex (warm) | 320 ms | 67 ms |
| Generation filter | 126 ms | 85 ms |
| Search ("char") | 45 ms | 45 ms |
| Open Summary | 271 ms | 197 ms |
| 100 sprites on one keep-alive connection | 4 320 ms | 50 ms |
| 20 API calls on one keep-alive connection | 880 ms | 5 ms |

These were the causes found:

1. **Delayed-ACK stall in the local server (largest).**
   - The server writes headers and body in separate packets. Without TCP_NODELAY, every response on a reused connection waited about 40 ms for a delayed ACK.
   - This affected every sprite and every API call in every window.
   - Fix: `disable_nagle_algorithm = True`. A regression test fails if it is switched off.
2. **Home downloaded the full 0.5 MB species list on every render and then discarded the Pokédex cache.** Home now uses the shared cached list.
3. **Every filter change and every return to the page rebuilt all 649 cards.** Card elements are now built once per loaded list and reused. Favourites, registrations, roster checks and imports reload the list, which invalidates the cache.
4. **Smaller costs:**
   - SVG icons are now cloned from a template.
   - Generation counts are computed once per list instead of once per heading.
   - Form search text is precomputed.
5. **Sprites could not be cached.** They were sent as `no-store`. They now have versioned URLs (`?v=<install>`) served as immutable, and unversioned requests stay `no-store`.

The grid keeps the static 36 px box icons (lazy, async decode). Animated GIFs appear only in the Summary. Virtualization was not needed.

## 3. Alternate-form artwork

The details are in `docs/research/phase-5/01-FORM-SPRITE-COVERAGE.md`.

- **Root cause.** Form data record ids (`client_record`) had been used as art ids. Slots 650–651 are eggs and 652–678 are Unown letters, so Wash Rotom (record 658) showed Unown H.
- **Slot map and fingerprints.** `companion/data/form_art.json` now has a separate, eye-checked slot map for each form key.
  - At runtime each slot is fingerprinted.
  - Egg and Unown placeholders, and byte-identical copies of the base species art (the Genesect Drives), are refused.
  - A file that has changed since the check is shown with a label.
- **Client art coverage.**
  - 56 of 82 forms are correct.
  - 4 Genesect Drives are refused as base art.
  - 22 forms (Arceus types, Therian formes, Black and White Kyurem, Keldeo Resolute) have no art in the client.
- **No substitution.** A form is never shown with base, Egg or Unown art. Without verified art the Summary says "No verified artwork for this form".
- **Optional animated sprite library** (Settings › Data). The Companion ships and hotlinks no artwork; you point it at your own copy of PokéAPI or Smogon sprites, as a folder or a .zip.
  - Files are accepted only for the exact species or form their path names: PokéAPI `black-white/animated[/shiny]/479-wash.gif`, Smogon `src/sprites/gen5/srotom-owash[-s].gif`, or Showdown `gen5ani[-shiny]/rotom-wash.gif`.
  - Each file is validated: real GIF/PNG, at most 2 MB, at most 256 px.
  - Back sprites and base-art copies are refused.
  - The library is installed with an atomic swap that has rollback and recovery. A failed import keeps the previous library, and your source folder is never modified.
- **Summary art.**
  - Order: animated (library) → still (library) → client battle sprite → client box icon → explicit "missing".
  - There is a normal/shiny toggle wherever a shiny version exists, including forms.
  - The ▶/❚❚ motion toggle is saved as `pokedex.animate`; by default it follows the system's reduced-motion setting. With motion off, a still frame is drawn on a canvas.
  - Art uses whole-number pixel scaling, and its source is shown under it.
- **Coverage.** PokéAPI has animated normal and shiny GIFs for all 82 forms and all 649 species. Smogon has all 82, but no shiny Unown F.

Reuse status:
- PokéAPI's repository is CC0, but it states the images are © The Pokémon Company.
- Smogon says the sprites are © Nintendo/GF/TPC, and its community-made sprites have no settled licence ("talk to us first").
- PokéSprite's images are © Nintendo/Creatures/GAME FREAK.

None of these allows redistribution, hence the user-supplied library. Synergy's sprite provider was not established.

## 4. PokeMMO accuracy and your checks

- The availability registry has no species confirmed as unavailable, so none were invented.
- The PokeMMO view hides `membership == "no"`, which today comes only from your own "Not listed" checks.
- Your checks stay in your database (`roster_checks`), are part of backups, survive restarts and updates, and are labelled "(your check)". They never change the bundled registry; a test confirms the file is byte-identical.
- Reference records are never removed (649 stay in the API). Virizion's permanent raid is intact.

## Fixed along the way

- The Summary's Escape handler was detached while a refresh rebuilt the page; for example, a "Not listed" click triggers one.
  - Effect: Escape was ignored for about a second, and a slow refresh could re-open a popup you had just closed.
  - Fix: Escape is now registered once, and an overtaken render stops.

## Tests

- **Backend** — new file `tests/test_sprites.py`:
  - form keys versus art entries (by key);
  - slot sanity, including the old Wash Rotom bug;
  - no artwork in the repo;
  - real-dump resolution and placeholder/changed detection;
  - GIF validation;
  - library import from PokéAPI, Smogon, Showdown and zip;
  - refusal of base copies;
  - failed import keeps the previous library;
  - interrupted swap recovery;
  - serving: cache headers, images only, no path escape;
  - report sprite ambiguity;
  - keep-alive latency;
  - Listed/Not listed persistence, filtering and personal scope.
- **UI** — new file `tests/ui/test_ui_sprites.py`:
  - Home and Live sprite sizes, pixelation and fallbacks;
  - TEST labels;
  - narrow windows and the reports popout;
  - card reuse, and no species refetch from Home;
  - generation counts;
  - static, lazy grid icons;
  - favourites and registration updating cached cards;
  - animated, shiny and still Summary art;
  - reduced motion;
  - missing form art;
  - Genesect Drives never showing base art;
  - verified client icons;
  - the Not-listed view, with Escape during a refresh.

Native KDE/Wayland and Windows shells were not run here, and the timings are from headless Chrome, not QtWebEngine on the owner's machine.
